title: Tendering Specialist

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Job Summary :**
The Business Head will own the growth of Nasons Industries LLP's solar project business, covering rooftop, ground-mounted and commercial and industrial (C&I) solar projects. The role is accountable for business strategy, revenue and profitability, and for building a strong pipeline through business development, sales and marketing. The incumbent will lead the project sales team, build relationships with industrial, commercial, institutional, builder and government customers, develop channel and EPC partnerships, and ensure that every order is converted, executed and collected in coordination with the engineering, procurement, project and finance teams.

**Key Responsibility :**

1. Business Strategy & P&L Ownership
2. Business Development and Sales
3. Marketing and Brand Building
4. Tender and Proposal Management
5. Commercial Negotiating and Contracting
6. Stakeholder and Customer Relation Management
7. Coordination with Internal teams and departments
8. Team Leadership
9. Reporting
10. Governance

**Company Description :**
Nasons Industries brings together India’s most trusted and innovative brands in solar-powered pumping systems and piping and water management solutions, ensuring customers never have to compromise on product quality. The company’s portfolio includes UPVC, CPVC, and SWR pipes, fittings, and storage tanks designed for plumbing, drainage, and water management across residential, agricultural, and industrial settings. Its solar range features high-efficiency panels, submersible pumps, and smart controllers that deliver reliable, sustainable water access while reducing energy costs and environmental impact. Nasons distinguishes itself by offering tailored solutions, taking the time to understand each customer’s requirements and providing honest advice, dependable service, and the right combination of brand and technology.

title: Insurance Agent
description:
**Company Description**
Reliance General Insurance is one of India’s leading private general insurance companies, offering over 94 customized products for corporate, SME, and individual customers. The company is known for innovative offerings, including India’s first over-the-counter health and home insurance policies. With more than 200 offices across 173 cities in 22 states, it provides a strong on-ground presence, wide distribution channels, and 24x7 customer service support. Reliance General Insurance was the first insurer in India to receive ISO 9001:2000 certification across all functions, processes, products, and locations. Its e-commerce platform enables customers to buy policies easily via the website or telephone/mobile, reflecting a strong commitment to digital convenience and customer experience.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Insurance Agent role based in Kolkata. The Insurance Agent will identify prospective clients, explain general insurance products, and recommend suitable coverage options tailored to customer needs. Daily responsibilities include generating leads, conducting consultations, preparing quotations, and assisting customers with policy issuance, renewals, endorsements, and claims support. The role involves maintaining accurate records of client interactions, complying with regulatory and company policies, and collaborating with internal teams and distribution partners to achieve sales targets. The Insurance Agent is expected to provide high-quality customer service, build long-term relationships, and contribute to overall business growth in the Kolkata region.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Insurance Sales and Insurance to effectively promote and explain general insurance products.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of Insurance Brokerage and related industry practices to manage policy placement and client advisory services.
* Candidates should possess a good understanding of Finance to interpret premium structures, coverage terms, and basic risk assessment.
* Candidates should possess excellent Customer Service skills to handle queries, resolve issues, and maintain long-term client relationships.
* Relevant experience in general insurance or financial services, preferably in sales or client-facing roles.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Ability to work with targets, manage time effectively, and maintain detailed documentation and reports.
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in any discipline; professional insurance certifications are an advantage.

title: Manager Purchase
description:
Position Summary
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Category Management & Strategic Sourcing
* Lead end-to-end category management and strategic procurement for capital equipment (Greenfield & Rebuild projects), MRO, and spare parts categories.
* Own the complete equipment build cycle: source individual parts, sub-assemblies, and heavy components from a global and domestic supplier base, coordinate inbound logistics, and support in-house assembly and trial runs.
* Prepare component-level budgets for new products, conduct comprehensive market and industry research to inform category strategies, and collaborate with business area stakeholders for project estimation and cost modelling.
* Establish and maintain framework agreements, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), price benchmarking tools, and should-cost models for diverse equipment and spare parts.
* Supplier Development, De-risking & Cost Optimization
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic suppliers; assess and enhance existing supplier capacities across Quality, Delivery, and Cost (QDC) parameters.
* Drive cost-saving initiatives through competitive tendering, strategic bundling, group purchasing volumes, and alternative supplier development (e.g., building robust local/national models to mitigate foreign supply chain dependencies).
* Perform sub-assembly level risk assessments before ordering, develop secondary/alternative sources to de-risks supply chains, and maintain production continuity.
* Act as the primary commercial point of contact for key partners, managing supplier performance evaluations and sharing insights transparently across internal engineering, production, and quality teams.
* Cross-functional Collaboration & Quality Compliance
* Partner closely with design, production, and quality assurance teams during assembly and trial phases to resolve part deviations, manage supplier claims, and ensure strict technical conformity.
* Ensure full compliance with corporate sourcing policies, internal approval workflows, ISO standards, and corporate procurement audits.
* Drive internal restructuring initiatives to optimize procurement performance, fostering clear accountability across specialized purchase, sourcing, and supply chain verticals.
* Digital Transformation & Systems Excellence
* Leverage advanced procurement tools—specifically SAP HANA (MM & SH modules) and JAGGAER (RFX, Auctions, SRM, Supplier Evaluation, and Spend Analytics)—to drive process transparency and data integrity.
* Manage vendor onboarding onto digital platforms, facilitating EDI-based data exchange, order confirmation, and digital offer submissions.
* Train cross-functional teams (Purchase, Quality, and Shipping) and external suppliers on digital procurement modules to enhance department-wide response efficiency and reporting accuracy.

title: Partnerships & Activations Lead
description:
**Job Title: Partnerships & Activations Lead**

**Location:**
Kolkata

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, work from office, with local travel

**Preferred Experience:**
3–5 years in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, brand activations or business development

**About Sevora**

Sevora is a stylist-led fashion shopping platform offering curated fashion, personal shopping assistance, Try at Home and express delivery in eligible locations. We help customers discover and purchase outfits with confidence and convenience.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a relationship-driven professional to build partnerships and deliver community activations that generate qualified leads, shopping appointments and sales.

You will develop a network across Kolkata’s residential communities, clubs, private social groups and complementary businesses. Working closely with Sales and the Personal Shopper, you will own partner acquisition, activation planning, execution, lead quality and cost efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Partnerships & Community Development**

* Build relationships with community hosts, residential associations, premium clubs, women’s groups and event organisers.
* Establish referral partnerships with salons, beauty studios, wedding planners, makeup artists and complementary lifestyle businesses.
* Develop partnership proposals and negotiate participation fees, promotional support, collaboration terms and referral arrangements.
* Maintain an active partner pipeline and monthly activation calendar.
* Develop productive partnerships into recurring shopping events and referral opportunities.

**2. Lead Generation & Appointment Booking**

* Deliver monthly targets for qualified customer leads and shopping appointments.
* Generate enquiries through kitty parties, private gatherings, residential communities, clubs, curated exhibitions, professional networks and referrals.
* Prepare channel plans with target audiences, activities, budgets and expected outcomes.
* Capture shopping preferences, budget, occasion, buying timeline and location to support lead qualification.
* Develop customer and community-host referral programmes with approved incentives and clear tracking.

**3. Activations & Event Execution**

* Plan and execute private shopping sessions, styling events, collection previews, pop-ups and community activations.
* Evaluate opportunities based on audience fit, purchase intent, participation costs and sales potential.
* Own event logistics, including permissions, venue arrangements, setup, displays, staffing coordination and partner communication.
* Coordinate invitations, lookbooks, QR codes, registration forms and promotional materials with Marketing and Creative teams.
* Coordinate assortment, stock availability, product movement and reconciliation with Merchandising and Operations.
* Work with Sales and the Personal Shopper to deliver shopping assistance and introduce eligible customers to Try at Home.
* Manage approved budgets and maintain records of expenses and partner commitments.

**4. Lead Handover & Sales Coordination**

* Capture accurate customer details and permission for follow-up.
* Record lead source, preferences, interest level and next action in the CRM.
* Hand over leads promptly to Sales with clear ownership and follow-up expectations.
* Review appointment attendance, follow-up progress, purchases and reasons for lost sales.
* Coordinate post-event follow-ups with Sales and retention campaigns with CRM.
* Use customer and sales feedback to improve future activations.

**5. Performance & Reporting**

* Report weekly on partner outreach, confirmed activities, qualified leads, appointments, costs and attributable sales.
* Track performance by partner, event and referral source using CRM tags, QR links or referral codes.
* Monitor cost per qualified lead, cost per purchasing customer and sales after cancellations and returns.
* Assess activation profitability with Finance using product margins and relevant costs.
* Recommend which partnerships and activities to expand, improve or discontinue.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Relevant experience in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, activations or business development.
* Strong networking, negotiation, presentation and relationship-management skills.
* Experience generating customer leads and delivering measurable commercial outcomes.
* Ability to manage activities independently, from outreach and planning to execution and reporting.
* Understanding of budgets, lead qualification, conversion and customer acquisition costs.
* Clear communication in Bengali, Hindi and English.
* Comfort using spreadsheets, presentations, WhatsApp Business and CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel within Kolkata and support scheduled evening or weekend events.

**Preferred Background**

Experience in fashion, premium retail, beauty, hospitality or lifestyle services. Existing relationships with Kolkata communities, clubs, residential associations and relevant businesses will be an advantage.

title: Regional RFQ Specialist
description:
At Pepperl+Fuchs, we combine a strong commitment to innovation with a deep respect for the traditions that have shaped our success. From renewable energy and automotive production to water treatment plants and chemical systems, our advanced electronic sensors and automation components enable smooth and safe operations around the globe.
  
  
We Take Pride In Fostering a Supportive And Collaborative Workplace Culture, Where Employees Feel Connected And Valued - Much Like a Close-knit Family. As We Continue To Grow, We Are Excited To Welcome a New Team Member For The Following Position
  
  
Regional RFQ Specialist
  
  
**Job Description: Regional RFQ Specialist – Explosion Protected Electrical Solutions**
**Role Title:**
Regional RFQ Specialist (Asia Support – India, South East Asia, South Korea, Japan, Australia)
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai, Bangalore or Mumbai, India
  
  
**Department:**
Regional Sales Support
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Sales Director APAC
  
  
**Summary Of Role**
We are seeking a highly detail-oriented, commercially minded, and technically proficient Regional RFQ Specialist to join our team at the Chennai Systems Engineering Centre (SEC). In this role, you will act as the dedicated expert on our Solution Engineering Centre capabilities, supporting regional RFQs and preparing technical/commercial proposals for Asia-based sales teams and customers. You will serve as the crucial technical interface between regional sales organizations, engineering, and production—analyzing complex customer specifications, developing competitive cost estimates, and designing hazardous area/explosion-protected electro-mechanical and LV panel solutions to drive regional business growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Tasks**

* Regional Proposal & RFQ Management (Asia Region)
* Act as the central 2nd level technical support interface for the Asia-wide sales network and regional sales organizations.
* Prepare accurate, competitive, and timely cost estimates, technical proposals, and formal RFQ submissions for explosion-protected electro-mechanical solutions and LV electrical panels.
* Ensure all quotations and RFQs are completed accurately and submitted within agreed timelines and regional KPI targets.
* Technical Analysis & Solution Design
* Review and technically qualify customer specifications, Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), wiring schematics, mechanical drawings, and international standards.
* Select suitable electrical components, switchgear, and enclosure configurations tailored to specific customer/project requirements in explosive gas or dust environments.
* Develop basic general arrangement (GA) drawings, preliminary solution designs, and detailed Bills of Materials (BOMs) for junction boxes, motor starter panels, and LV panel solutions.
* Perform technical feasibility studies and calculations to support customer quotations.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Interface
* Collaborate closely with Regional Sales, Local Engineering, R&D, Product Management, and Production teams to ensure technical and commercial compliance.
* Support regional sales teams in pricing strategies, price-finding situations, and technical query resolution.
* Directly (or via regional sales teams) interact with Asia-based clients to clarify technical requirements and present engineered proposals.

**Role Requirements & Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree, or B.Tech in Electrical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering.
* Experience:
* 5+ years of relevant experience in pre-sales support, electrical panel design, estimation, or costing.
* Prior experience in a 2nd-level technical sales support or pre-sales engineering role for control, instrumentation, or electro-mechanical products is highly preferred.

**Technical Skills & Knowledge**

* Hazardous Area Knowledge: Familiarity with explosion-protected equipment (Ex-d, Ex-e, etc.) and global standards (e.g., IECEx, ATEX) for explosive gas or dust atmospheres.
* Electrical & Mechanical Literacy: Strong ability to read, interpret, and analyze wiring schematics, mechanical drawings, technical specifications, and single-line diagrams (SLDs).
* Product Expertise: Deep understanding of Low Voltage (LV) electrical panels, motor starter panels, switchgear, and junction box configurations.
* Software Proficiency:
* Proficient in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word).
* Knowledge of AutoCAD / 2D Electro-CAD tools or ERP systems is a strong advantage.

**Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Communication: Excellent written and spoken English communication skills; comfortable acting as a regional bridge between engineering and international sales offices.
* Commercial Acumen: Ability to balance technical compliance with cost-effective engineering.
* Detail-Oriented & Organized: Proven ability to manage multiple regional queries simultaneously under tight deadlines.

title: Member
description:
**Company Description**
MeHAN is a human-centered advisory firm focused on closing the gap between buying AI tools and actually using them effectively in organizations. Instead of traditional button-click training, MeHAN addresses the real barriers to AI adoption, such as fear, resistance, leadership gaps, and cultural signals. The company uses diagnostic, data-driven insights tailored to each client’s unique context, avoiding generic best practices. Built specifically for India’s mid-market companies with 100 to 2,000 employees, MeHAN follows a structured four-step process from free pulse checks to custom programs that measurably improve AI adoption. Applicants join a team committed to making AI investments meaningful, practical, and measurable for clients.
  
**Role Description**
As a Member at MeHAN, you will work full time on-site in the Greater Kolkata Area, contributing to diagnostic-led advisory projects that help clients improve AI adoption. You will support the design and delivery of pulse checks and team-wide diagnostics, gather and interpret organizational data, and help translate findings into clear, actionable insights for client teams. You will collaborate with colleagues to shape custom programs that address behavioral, cultural, and leadership barriers to AI usage, and assist in tracking impact and adoption metrics over time. The role involves direct interaction with client stakeholders, participation in workshops and discussions, and ongoing documentation and reporting to ensure clarity, consistency, and measurable outcomes.
  
**Qualifications**

* Ability to understand organizational behavior, culture, and change dynamics, and apply these insights to improve technology adoption.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience working with diagnostic data, surveys, or structured assessments.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings and recommendations to diverse stakeholder groups.
* Comfort working in client-facing environments, with skills in collaboration, facilitation, and building trust across teams.
* Interest in AI, digital transformation, or technology-enabled change, and willingness to learn about emerging tools and practices.
* Ability to work on-site full time in the Greater Kolkata Area, managing priorities and deadlines in a fast-moving advisory setting.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, psychology, sociology, technology, or a related field is preferred; relevant experience in consulting, HR, L&D, or transformation roles is an advantage.
* Demonstrated integrity, respect for diverse perspectives, and commitment to non-discriminatory, inclusive work practices.

title: Cloud Security Architect
description:
**The Company:**
Varonis (Nasdaq: VRNS) is a leader in data security, fighting a different battle than conventional cybersecurity companies. Our cloud-native Data Security Platform continuously discovers and classifies critical data, removes exposures, and detects advanced threats with AI-powered automation.
  
  
Thousands of organizations worldwide trust Varonis to defend their data wherever it lives — across SaaS, IaaS, and hybrid cloud environments. Customers use Varonis to automate a wide range of security outcomes, including data security posture management (DSPM), data classification, data access governance (DAG), data detection and response (DDR), data loss prevention (DLP), and insider risk management.
  
  
Varonis protects data first, not last. Learn more at www.varonis.com.
  
  
**The Role:**
We are seeking a Cloud Security Architect that will be responsible for assisting Sales Representatives, Sales Engineers and Partners with the technical sales activities in net-new and upsell opportunities. **The Location:**
Remote, India based.
  
  
The Requirements:
  
  

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent from a four-year College or Technical School AND 3-5 years of experience in a customer facing role OR equivalent combination or education and experience.
* Strong written, oral, and presentation skills.
* Ability to discuss highly technical concepts to all audiences, ranging from non-technical to executive level decision makers.
* Extensive knowledge of one of the following domains: AWS, Azure, Salesforce.
* Exposure to administration of Cloud applications including: Box, GitHub, Okta, Zoom, Jira, Slack.
* Exposure to security hardware and software.
* Salesforce Certified Administrator, AWS Cloud Practitioner/Associate/Professional, and Google Cloud Security Professional are preferred.

The Responsibilities:
  
  

* Understand customer requirements and integrate Varonis solutions into the customers’ environment.

* Leverage Cloud infrastructure knowledge to navigate architecture design conversations, assess technical issues, and overcome obstacles to capture revenue.
* Create and provide product and business value enablement training for sales, SEs, and partners.
* Ability to work independently and team collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to articulate the importance of Cloud Security Analytics and Threat Detection and evangelize Varonis as the leader in the market to end-users of all levels.

Manager Business Consulting - IT
  
  
**Kolkata, West Bengal, India | Working Scheme: On-Site | Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE | Reference Code: req33939**
It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
  
  
The Manager Business Consulting will act as a business-facing IT partner by managing the application lifecycle and providing effective post-implementation support for Sales and Supply processes across the RSE region
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
  
  
Every day is an opportunity: an opportunity to learn, to grow, to share success, and to contribute to one of the world’s leading industrial gas and engineering companies. Seize the opportunity: take your next step with us and join our team.
  
  
Linde values diversity and recognizes the importance of fostering inclusion in our work environment. We believe that our success depends on the diverse perspectives of our employees, customers, and global markets. As an employer of choice, we strive to support our employees' growth, welcome new ideas, and respect our differences.
  
  
Team
  
  
Making an impact. What will you do?
  
  

* In this role you will participate as a core project team member in the implementation of SAP and non-SAP applications, including system interfaces, across the RSE region
* Further you will own the application development lifecycle for assigned initiatives by working with business users to gather and document requirements, translating them into SAP process designs, developing the functional specifications, configuring SAP solutions, collaborating closely with ABAP developers for custom developments, performing system testing, supporting user acceptance test and ensuring successful deployment.
* Furthermore, you will identify process gaps and propose workarounds where required
* Moreover, you will provide end-to-end SAP application support for Sales and Supply systems across the relevant modules (e.g. SD, MM/PP/PM, Procurement, SAP authorisations, integrated FI/CO areas), including issue troubleshooting, user training, data cleansing and post go-live support
* Further you will maintain accurate and up-to-date system documentation, including business requirements, solution designs, configuration details and user/training manuals
* Moreover, you will act as a business process specialist by maintaining a strong understanding of Sales and Supply processes including OTC, PTP, R2R and master data management
* Additionally, you will collaborate with Global IT teams (including GIMS, BASIS, Release Management, TCOE, Global Business Consulting), Shared Services, regional and country IT teams, and external vendors to ensure successful project delivery and support

Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
  
  

* For this role you will have a degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or other disciplines with strong interest in business consulting and a solid understanding of IT and business applications
* Further you have a minimum of 3 years’ experience in system implementations, particularly in SAP SD
* Furthermore, you have a strong business knowledge and understanding of Sales and Supply processes
* Additionally, you have the ability to work in a global environment and travel as required

Why you will love working for us!
  
  
Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company, operating in more than 100 countries worldwide. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain and protect our planet.
  
  
On the 1st of April 2020, Linde India Limited and Praxair India Private Limited successfully formed a joint venture, LSAS Services Private Limited. This company will provide Operations and Management (O&M) services to both existing organizations, which will continue to operate separately. LSAS carries forward the commitment towards sustainable development, championed by both legacy organizations. It also takes ahead the tradition of the development of processes and technologies that have revolutionized the industrial gases industry, serving a variety of end markets including chemicals & refining, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, and primary metals.
  
  
At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
  
  
We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.

title: SAP PM CS
description:
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven
**SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant**
with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).

+ Act as the primary liaison between EY and Microsoft, nurturing the alliance to maximize mutual benefits.
+ Identify opportunities for co-selling, joint initiatives, and strategic investments with Microsoft.
+ Maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across Microsoft and other relevant partners to enhance partnership performance.

* Technology Expertise

+ Demonstrate an in-depth understanding of Microsoft Business Applications, including Dynamics 365 (Sales, Finance, Supply Chain), Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate), and Azure.
+ Stay up to date with new features, releases, and advancements in the Microsoft ecosystem and communicate these insights effectively to both internal and external stakeholders.

* Business Growth & Innovation

+ Leverage your industry exp

**Essential Functions Of The Job**

* Leadership and team management, including talent acquisition, development, and retention
* Works with EY teams to ensure One Microsoft approach
* Develop and manage the GTM strategy for Microsoft Dynamics 365,
* Power Platform, and other Microsoft Business Apps, focusing on key growth opportunities.
* Technical oversight and quality assurance of deliverables
* Standardizes, simplifies, and modernizes the delivery practices
* Business development and client relationship management
* Financial management of the practice's operations

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities**

* Professional with the ability to make most of the decisions pertaining to practice growth, investment in new areas of technology and people issues
* Defining location strategy with respect to global locations, building integrated operating model, identifying right pricing, and acquiring local talent
* Sharp focus on building competitive cost of delivery
* Defining winning themes and building differentiated solutions

**Education & Experience**

* Minimum of bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems Management, or a related field with 20 years of experience. Graduate from top colleges is a huge plus
* Microsoft certifications in Dynamics 365 and Power Platforms with technical delivery experience in Dynamics 365 CRM App, PowerApps,
* Power platform, Front and Back-office integrations, Microsoft Azure DevOps.
* Experience of managing practice/accounts with HC above 200+ would be a huge plus
* Demonstrated record in driving revenue within existing clients and in developing new prospects at the “C” level of Fortune 500 companies
* Demonstrated ability to work successfully within a matrixed organization and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering advisory services.

**Knowledge And Skills Requirements**

* Technology expertise, in Microsoft solutions focused on D365 and power platforms, 20 years across roles spanning client delivery, innovation, solution architecting, people, and program management. At least last 10+ years in technical leadership roles
* Demonstrates Dynamics and Power Platform technical expertise including associated Microsoft stack implementation technologies such as Azure, SharePoint, and Exchange/Outlook, with a proven ability to sell and execute large scale consulting engagements with a distributed delivery mindset
* Strong reputation in the talent market and the ability to build a strong & continuous talent pipeline, based on one’s reputation and prior successes.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics CRM Technical Senior Specialized:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Lead / Senior Consultant to design, deliver, and optimize enterprise-grade D365 and Power Platform solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise with solution ownership, team leadership, and stakeholder engagement to drive business outcomes across complex CRM environments.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development, configuration, and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions aligned with business requirements and best practices.
* Architect and deliver end-to-end solutions across D365 modules including Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Field Service.

**What We Look For**

* Experience working in Agile delivery environments (Scrum/Kanban).
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Power Platform certifications are preferred.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**
**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**
Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM
  
  

* Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**
**Senior/Manager**
**Experience**
**8–12 years**
**LOCATION**
EY GDS
  
  

* Hybrid

**ORIENTATION**
**Strategy-led**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.
  
  
You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.
  
  
**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**
**40%**
**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
Win themes, solution storyline, client orals
  
  
**30%**
**Go-To-Market & Offerings**
Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances
  
  
**30%**
**AI Strategy & Advisory**
Roadmaps, business cases, operating models
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
AI Strategy & Value Advisory
  
  
■ Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.
  
  
■ Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery → MVP → scale).
  
  
■ Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.
  
  
■ Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
■ Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.
  
  
Go-To-Market & Offering Development
  
  
■ Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.
  
  
■ Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.
  
  
■ Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.
  
  
■ Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.
  
  
■ Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.
  
  
RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits
  
  
■ Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.
  
  
■ Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.
  
  
■ Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.
  
  
■ Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.
  
  
■ Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.
  
  
AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)
  
  
■ Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.
  
  
■ Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.
  
  
■ Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.
  
  
■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes**
Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.
  
  
■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.
  
  
■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.
  
  
■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.
  
  
■ Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.
  
  
■ Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
■ GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)
  
  
■ Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.
  
  
■ APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.
  
  
IDEAL PROFILE
  
  
**You will thrive here if you…**
■ Have taken AI / data products from 0 → 1 and know what drives adoption
  
  
■ Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal
  
  
■ Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO
  
  
■ Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs
  
  
**This role is not…**
■ A hands-on engineering or model-building role
  
  
■ Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks
  
  
■ Pure delivery / project management
  
  
■ A back-office bid-desk formatting role
  
  
WHY JOIN US
  
  
■ Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.
  
  
■ Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.
  
  
■ Collaborate with a team of AI experts, solution architects, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
■
**Continuous learning**
— You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  
  
■
**Success as defined by you**
— We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  
  
■
**Transformative leadership**
— We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  
  
■
**Diverse and inclusive culture**
— You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

description:

We are looking for an

who can manage a small technical team, drive product implementations, and work closely with our engineering and customer teams to deliver reliable solutions.

* Lead and coordinate a team of engineers working on product development and implementation.
* Understand customer requirements and translate them into actionable technical tasks.

* Work closely with developers to build, integrate, test, and deploy software solutions.

* Maintain implementation documentation and establish effective development and deployment practices.

* Familiarity with Git, Docker, and application deployment.
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Exposure to AI/ML or Generative AI applications is an advantage, but extensive specialised experience is not required.

**Team Leadership & Project Management**

* Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating a team of developers or engineers.
* Ability to break down requirements into tasks, assign responsibilities, and track execution.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Ability to identify blockers, solve problems, and keep projects moving.
* Comfortable working directly with customers and communicating technical requirements.
* A proactive approach to ownership, accountability, and team collaboration.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with LLM-based applications, RAG, AI agents, or other Generative AI solutions.
* Familiarity with vector databases and AI application frameworks.
* Exposure to cloud-based AI deployments or GPU infrastructure.
* Experience with vLLM, SGLang, or private and sovereign AI deployments.
* Experience working in a product company, startup, or client-facing engineering environment.

title: Outbound Lead Development Representative – National
description:
**About Duratuf**

We're an industrial safety company in Kolkata, with our own office and warehouse in Dubai

Our equipment keeps workers safe at
**4,142+ customers**
across
**65+ countries**
— when it works, someone gets to go home to their family.

We're on our way to
**10,000 protected workplaces by 2035**

**About the Role**

* Demand generation engine of our national outbound motion, with India as your market
* Research target companies in our focus industries and develop interest into sales-ready opportunities
* Move each contact from Prospect (MQL) to a sales-qualified lead (SQL) that Sales accepts, with a meeting on the calendar
* Full-cycle prospecting seat: you own the bridge into Sales, you do not negotiate or close, and you carry no pricing authority
* Fully digital and desk-based, with no field visits

**Research and Target**

* Identify and research target companies in India against the defined ideal customer profile (ICP)
* Build and maintain target account lists
* Map the decision-makers and buying committee in each account

**Enrich and Maintain Data**

* Source and validate contact information using approved tools
* Keep every prospect record in CRM accurate, complete and up to date

**Pitch and Develop**

* Reach out by email, LinkedIn, phone and WhatsApp (where applicable)
* Personalise every message and follow the defined sequences and cadences
* Open real conversations with plant, EHS, safety and procurement buyers

**Qualify MQL to SQL**

* Run a structured qualification against the criteria set by management and Sales
* Capture buying signals and make an honest qualify or reject call on every lead
* Understand each account's scope and potential

**Fix the Meeting**

* Secure a genuine meeting or next step with Sales and hand over cleanly
* Move real opportunities forward, not just pricing requests

**Build Qualified Pipeline**

* Develop and maintain a qualified pipeline for Sales, with clear opportunity value

**Keep the CRM Honest**

* Log every contact, activity, disposition and stage in CRM in real time

**Feed the Loop**

* Track outreach and conversion metrics and join the weekly performance review
* Share learnings back to demand generation and Sales so targeting and criteria keep getting sharper

**How Success Is Measured**

* MQL to SQL qualification against the agreed criteria
* SQL acceptance by Sales: a meeting fixed and taken forward, not just a request for pricing
* Pipeline value handed to Sales (for example, INR pipeline developed)
* GP contribution from qualified opportunities that convert into orders

**Requirements**

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 2-4 years in B2B lead generation, inside sales, presales, SDR / LDR or outbound business development
* Comfortable owning a daily qualification and calling number

description:

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
EY GDS Cybersecurity is seeking an experienced IAM AI Manager to help clients modernize their Identity and Access Management landscape through AI-led transformation. This role focuses on identifying where AI can improve IAM operations, governance, access risk management, privileged access, and non-human identity controls across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work closely with clients and delivery teams to translate IAM challenges into practical, scalable, and reusable AI-enabled solutions. The role requires strong IAM domain understanding, consulting leadership, and the ability to shape solution approaches that improve identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, privileged access, compliance posture, and emerging areas such as agent, workload, and service identities.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of IAM experience, AI awareness, solution design capability, and stakeholder-facing communication skills. This profile is expected to guide discovery, define the IAM-AI vision, support PoCs and MVPs, and help clients adopt intelligent, risk-aware, and secure identity operations without losing focus on control, auditability, and business value.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical architecture & design**

* Define IAM-AI solution architecture across IGA, AM/SSO, PAM, directory services, NHI, and security operations use cases.
* Translate client IAM challenges into scalable AI-enabled workflows, PoCs, MVPs, and implementation roadmaps.
* Guide secure integration of identity data, AI models, automation scripts, APIs, analytics, and cloud services to improve IAM operations and risk visibility.
* Provide hands-on direction using Python, PowerShell, APIs, and automation patterns to validate and accelerate solution delivery.

**LLM, Reasoning & Knowledge Engineering**

* Design AI-led IAM use cases using LLMs, RAG, agents, copilots, orchestration frameworks, and responsible AI guardrails.
* Apply AI/ML techniques to support access risk analysis, anomaly detection, role mining, certification insights, and privileged access intelligence.
* Support secure NHI and agent identity governance covering discovery, inventory, authentication, authorization, and guardrails.

**IAM integration automation leadership**

* Lead client workshops, discovery, solution shaping, estimation, roadmap definition, and executive-level IAM-AI storytelling.
* Design AI-enabled governance capabilities across SailPoint, Saviynt, access reviews, lifecycle management, provisioning, SOD, and compliance reporting.
* Shape PAM automation and analytics across CyberArk, privileged access patterns, session monitoring, password rotation, secrets, and risk-based remediation.
* Develop client-ready insights and dashboards using identity data, analytics, automation, and visualization tools.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills**

* 7+ years of experience in IAM, cybersecurity consulting, AI architecture, intelligent automation, or advanced analytics.
* Strong understanding of IAM domains including IGA, AM/SSO, PAM, AD/Entra ID, NHI, lifecycle management, governance, provisioning, access reviews, and risk scoring.
* Working knowledge of AI concepts such as LLMs, RAG, AI agents, copilots, orchestration, embeddings, and cloud AI services.
* Hands-on experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, automation scripts, data pipelines, and cloud-native integration patterns.
* Good understanding of IAM protocols and controls including SAML, OAuth, OIDC, MFA, Conditional Access, federation, authorization, and certificate/key management.
* Strong consulting, communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and executive storytelling skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in Big 4, GDS, global delivery, or consulting-led environments.
* Ability to create PoC/MVP plans, architecture views, roadmap slides, executive summaries, and client demos.
* Exposure to IAM modernization, NHI governance, privileged access transformation, AI adoption, and responsible AI controls.
* Relevant working knowledge or certifications across CISSP, CISM, Azure AI, Google ML, Saviynt, SailPoint, CyberArk, or cloud security are preferred.

**Certifications, Compliance & Assurance**

* Ensure IAM-AI solutions are secure, auditable, explainable, and aligned with client risk, compliance, and assurance expectations.
* Define governance guardrails for AI-driven identity operations, NHI controls, privileged access automation, access recommendations, data handling, and model-assisted decisions.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**

**How to Apply**

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

description:

**About Submer**
Submer enables organizations scaling AI to overcome the limits of traditional datacenters across power, compute density and efficiency.
  
  
We design and deliver scalable, high-density AI datacenter infrastructure built around industry-leading liquid cooling, supporting everything from early AI deployments to full-scale production environments.**

title: Manager — Business Growth & Tender Management
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly organised, business-oriented professional to serve as a direct extension of the Founders and Sales Leadership team. This role combines strategic pre-sales support, business operations, cross-functional coordination, and end-to-end government and institutional tender management — making it a uniquely broad role suited for someone with strong execution orientation, commercial instincts, and experience navigating e-procurement ecosystems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Pre-Sales & Business Development Support
* Support Founders and Sales Leaders throughout the full sales lifecycle
* Coordinate customer presentations, technical proposals, RFP/RFQ responses, concept notes, and solution documents
* Work with Engineering, Product, and Delivery teams to gather technical inputs for proposals
* Maintain proposal repositories and sales collateral
* Coordinate customer demonstrations, PoCs, and strategic meetings
* Conduct market, customer, and competitor research
* Track strategic opportunities and follow-ups until closure
* Tender Management & e-Procurement
* Identify, track, and evaluate relevant government and institutional tenders across e-procurement portals — GeM, CPP Procurement Portal, MSTC, state portals (e-Tender WB, APTS, KTPP, eProcure, etc.)
* Manage end-to-end tender lifecycle: sourcing → eligibility analysis → document preparation → submission → follow-up → bid opening → post-tender correspondence
* Read and interpret tender documents including scope of work, technical specifications, EMD/SD requirements, eligibility criteria, and commercial terms
* Coordinate with Finance for EMD / Bank Guarantee / SD arrangements and ensure timely submission
* Prepare and compile all required documents for tender submission — technical bid, price bid, company credentials, certifications, and compliance statements
* Maintain and update tender tracking registers (ongoing, submitted, awarded, lost) with status and follow-up actions
* Monitor e-procurement portal portals and client websites for relevant tender notices — IoT, CAAQMS, environmental monitoring, smart infrastructure, IIoT sectors
* Liaise with government departments, PSUs, and institutional clients for tender clarifications, corrigendum updates, and bid openings
* Maintain login credentials, DSC (Digital Signature Certificate) renewals, portal registrations, and vendor empanelments
* Coordinate with technical and legal teams to ensure all responses to pre-qualification questionnaires and technical queries are accurate and submitted on time
* Analyse lost tenders for lessons learned and support improvement of future bid strategies
* Maintain a repository of standard tender documents, pre-qualified certifications, and company credentials ready for rapid deployment
* Customer & Sales Operations
* Coordinate customer communications, documentation, and project discussions
* Support contract review by highlighting commercial, technical, and operational aspects
* Maintain CRM, opportunity trackers, and sales dashboards
* Coordinate seamless handover from Sales to Delivery
* Cross-Functional Program Management
* Drive execution across strategic initiatives
* Track deliverables, dependencies, and timelines
* Identify bottlenecks and escalate proactively
* Continuously improve internal coordination processes

**Requirements**

* Good hands-on experience working with Government clients
* Hands-on experience in bidding and government bidding portal/site management
* Experience in preparing deal collateral
* Notice Period: Immediate or shorter notice period preferred
* Language Skills: Bengali fluency is essential; must be fluent in English with strong vocal command for presentations

**Preferred Qualifications**

* B.E. / B.Tech with MBA — Mandatory

Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

* Provide technical and clinical leadership during the sales process by demonstrating the full range of Ultrasound products, including potential uses, product capabilities, and customer benefits.
* Coordinate, schedule, and execute objective-based system training for customers and channel partners; monitor and report on training outcomes.

* Penetrate competitive accounts and provide current market intelligence to the business.

* Serve as the focal point for the modality/team by identifying customer satisfaction issues, assisting with escalations, resolving problems, and addressing specialty training requests.
* Advocate for and support the adoption of hybrid training delivery models for customers.
* Maintain well-documented pre- and post-training records in alignment with global guidelines.
* Responsible for pre- and post-sales support of ultrasound systems. Responsibilities include conducting clinical activities such as workshops, CMEs, webinars, and hands-on training.

title: TC-CS-AEET-Senior-ZT
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Cyber Security – Technology Consulting – Infrastructure Security – Zero Trust Security - Senior**
As part of our EY Cyber Security team, you shall be responsible for defining, solutioning, integrating, and implementing innovative solutions which will enhance our service delivery quality, as well as help us strategically elevate technology driven transformation for our clients. You’ll also help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for an Infrastructure Security professional with solution mindset and hands on security engineering expertise in Zero Trust Security, risk and controls concepts, architecture design. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the rollout of next generation market relevant solutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* A Security- Design & Architect professional who is responsible for designing, building, testing and implementing security within an organisation’s IT infrastructure- On Prem & Cloud.
* Professional is expected to have a thorough understanding of complex IT systems and stay up to date with the latest security standards, systems and authentication protocols, as well as best practice security products.
* Identify requirements, design document and implement technical solutions for scalable and resilient network architecture.
* Well versed with Zero Trust use cases , business & technical requirements.
* Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
* Experience in Zero-Trust and micro-segmentation solutions including Guardicore and Illumio.
* Individual should possess experience in planning, design, deployment, configuration, integration and management of network protection controls including Next gen firewalls- Palo Alto, Checkpoint, Fortinet, SDN Security, DDoS Protection, IPS, VPN, Wireless security, NAC and network authentication solutions to protect IT assets and should be responsible for deployment of any changes, plug-ins, or configuration as requested by client.
* Proven expertise in designing and delivering SASE transformations across leading platforms such as Palo Alto, Netskope, Zscaler, and Fortinet, including strategy and assessment, vendor selection, PoC validation, architecture design, and enterprise-scale implementation.
* Plan, design, deploy, configure, integrate, and manage WAF, proxy/Zscaler solutions.
* Possess hands on experience in segmenting networks, applications, and data to limit exposure to attacks.
* Plan, design, deploy, configure, integrate and manage platform protection controls including virtualisation protection solutions on Hypervisors and thin client’s security solutions.
* Good understanding of security concepts and technologies including, but not limited to TCP/IP, LDAP, DHCP, DNS, web filtering etc.
* Should be well-versed with network documentation that includes network drawings, text descriptions and equipment configurations, designing HLDs and LLDs.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Serve as highly technical security expert to bring security transformation to both new and legacy infrastructure.
* Deep technical understanding of architecture and solutioning of infrastructure security components.
* Deep knowledge of services and service delivery approach and methodology for infrastructure security including governance and operating models.
* Proven track record in building and maintaining trusted relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel and flex work timings as and when required.
* Ability to change and adapt in a hyper-growth environment.
* Self-starter and strategic thinker.
* Drive C-suite/senior leadership level meetings and discussion.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and executive presence that enable effective engagement with senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and communicate the technical and security related issues to client/business stakeholders.
* Clearly demonstrates proven extensive abilities with leveraging creative thinking and problem-solving skills, individual initiative, and utilizing Office 365, MS Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint) and Google Docs.
* Communicating in an organized and knowledgeable manner in written and verbal formats including delivering clear requests for information and communicating potential conflicts.
* Must communicate consistently and drive objectives, relying on fact-based decisions about risk that optimize the trade-off between risk mitigation and business performance.
* Good presentation, project management, facilitation and delivery skills as well as strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to create domain specific training content and deliver training effectively.
* Develop/Implement automation solutions and capabilities that are clearly aligned to client business, technology and threat posture.
* Demonstrates ability to track developments and changes in the digital business and threat environments to ensure that they're adequately addressed in client’s security strategy plans and architecture artefacts.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 6+ years of experience in Information Technology experience, with specialization in Cyber Security roles that include multiple areas of specialization. Professional-level knowledge in areas from the following:

+ Zero Trust Security Strategy and Implementation
+ Security Engineering & Architecture assessments
+ Possess understanding in firewalls, VPNs, NAC, SDWAN, WAF, Proxy, EDR/XDR etc.
+ Expert level experience with deployment, maintenance and operations of one or more major network security Devices
+ Cloud Security Architecture
+ Entrepreneurial approach to solving security problems with consultative skills
+ Well versed with Zero Trust use cases , business & technical requirements.
+ Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
+ Experience in Zero-Trust and micro-segmentation solutions including Guardicore and Illumio.
+ Individual should possess experience in planning, design, deployment, configuration, integration and management of network protection controls including Next gen firewalls- Palo Alto, Checkpoint, Fortinet, SDN Security, DDoS Protection, IPS, VPN, Wireless security, NAC and network authentication solutions to protect IT assets and should be responsible for deployment of any changes, plug-ins, or configuration as requested by client.
+ Proven expertise in designing and delivering SASE transformations across leading platforms such as Palo Alto, Netskope, Zscaler, and Fortinet, including strategy and assessment, vendor selection, PoC validation, architecture design, and enterprise-scale implementation.
+ Plan, design, deploy, configure, integrate, and manage WAF, proxy/Zscaler solutions.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good soft skills i.e. verbal & written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF, Zscaler)

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
