title: Account Management - Senior Associate
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As an Account Management - Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in driving business growth and maintaining a positive reputation for the organization. You will focus on building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, confirming their needs are met, and providing exceptional service. Within our Internal Firm Services practice, you will leverage your skills to develop and execute strategic sales and marketing initiatives, driving revenue growth and enhancing brand visibility.
  
  
As a Senior Associate, you will be responsible for building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality outcomes. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, using these moments as opportunities to grow.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will utilize market research, digital marketing, creative campaigns, and effective sales strategies to engage clients and achieve organizational targets. Your work will involve understanding client goals, managing accounts, and employing strategies to build trust and loyalty, ultimately contributing to the firm's success.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as an independent contributor, liaising directly with the Account Manager, Lead Client Partner and account teams, taking end-to-end ownership of all activities for the accounts/ sector/industry they are align
* Act as a key liaison between offshore and onshore teams to align client priorities, account strategies and delivery expectations
* Partner with Account Managers and cross-functional teams to develop and execute strategic sales, account management and marketing initiatives
* Support Account Manager and LCP on account planning by conducting market research and analysis, pipeline and past sales analysis, tracking pursuits, and contributing to account strategy development
* Deliver and update accurate Salesforce reports, dashboards and account meeting materials, providing clear visibility into pipeline status, financials, client activities and follow-up actions
* Managing client accounts by understanding their goals and providing exceptional service to meet their needs- Utilizing analytical thinking and client profiling to develop strategic sales and marketing initiatives
* Engaging in sales account planning and sales enablement to capture new business opportunities- Collaborating with teams to execute creative campaigns and digital marketing strategies
* Applying critical thinking to break down complex concepts and generate innovative solutions
* Interpreting data to inform insights and recommendations for client engagement strategies- Upholding professional and technical standards in all client interactions and account management activities.
* Navigating complex situations to anticipate client needs and deliver quality service.
* Leveraging customer relationship management tools to enhance client satisfaction and loyalty
* Lead a team of associates for account management deliverables, drive innovation in account management, and act as a coach to develop talent in the firm
* Be a champion of the firm’s standard business development methodology (Pursuit) and the use of sales best practices within your assigned clients
* Be an advocate and trainer for Salesforce, promoting its effective use, and support practice staff with advice and assistance on best practices

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least 5 years of relevant experience in sales support, marketing, account management, client engagement or a related role; relevant PwC or professional services firm experience may also be considered
* Demonstrated experience supporting client accounts, stakeholder relationships, sales operations, or business development activities.
* Proficiency in Salesforce CRM and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, Copilot, Power BI.
* Effective project management and organizational skills with a high level of attention to detail, and Strong communication skills in English at Professional Level.
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Experience in using CRM technology to improve account management operations and data-driven insights to provide account visibility to support account growth.
* Working knowledge of financial analysis, account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and account operations.
* Ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and communicate practical recommendations to stakeholders.
* Critical thinking and problem-solving skills, particularly in complex or time-sensitive situations.
* Self-awareness, learning agility, and a proactive approach to strengthening capabilities and addressing development areas.
* Build strong relationships and encourage effective teamwork.
* Executing projects as per defined guidelines and SLAs
* Analyzing and reporting data using dashboards and reporting formats
* Ability to work flexible shifts aligned with Canadian business hours, with coverage required until 1:00 a.m. IST; accordingly, the work day may begin later
* Demonstrating proficiency in client management and stakeholder engagement
* Utilizing analytical thinking to inform strategic decisions- Excelling in customer relationship management and satisfaction
* Developing sales account planning and sales enablement strategies
* Navigating complex client profiles and counseling needs- Building meaningful client connections through effective communication

Shift time: :2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST (candidates should be flexible to extend their work hours until 1:00 AM IST)

title: EXECUTIVE N - AID RELATIONSHIP (Kolkata)
description:
Location:
  
  
Kolkata, WB, IN
  
  
Areas of Work: Sales & Marketing Job Id: 15356
  
  
**External Job Description**
Role Overview:
  
  
This is a field role focused on building and maintaining strong relationships with Architects & Interior Designers (AIDs). It focuses on various Home Décor product categories such as Luxury Lights, Kitchen & Wardrobe, Bath Fittings & Sanitaryware, UPVC Windows & Doors, Textures, Wood Finishes, Wallpapers, Fabrics, etc.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain relationships with existing AIDs and service their requirements.
* Onboarding new AIDs and creating a database of all active architects in defined geography.
* Maintain & Update CML (Customer Master List) for AIDs.
* Plan potential business in your territory & categories via AIDs.
* Lead generation by showcasing offerings through catalogs & brochures and informing AIDs about new launches and product updates, followed by scheduling meetings to strengthen engagement.
* Conduct site visits to end customers’ homes, act as the Point of Contact (POC) for escalations, and ensure a smooth experience during home décor integration.
* Coordinate with business category teams for backend support and seamless execution.
* Maintain tracker with weekly visits to architects and updates on:
* Number of catalogs/collaterals distributed
* Number of product briefings conducted
* Number of AID sites visited.

title: Engagement Executive | 15+ years | Chennai
description:

A Engagement Executive is a senior level role, driving business impact and securing the strategic goals and objectives for a key client or portfolio key clients of Capgemini Business Services.
  
  
As face of Capgemini Business Services for C-level client stakeholders, is expected to represent and secure our client’s brand with their customers, stakeholders, and investors (NPS, other customer experience programs). The key success factors of the role include building strong client partnerships, executing a strong delivery and transformation organization, managing to the contract and growth of the engagement.
  
  
**Primary Skills**
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Delivering the contracted scope to the client and manage the contract obligations for the client
* Shaping up and cocreating where needed, proactive proposals with client leading to a sole source renewal and expansion
* Should be a strong Influencer at clients C – Suite and should be able articulate our value proposition, capability to become and sustain being a strategic partner.
* Accountable for engagement budget and actuals, delivering the contracted revenue and margin
* Deep dive into operational issues resolution and building proactive control environment to prevent operational issues
* Bringing inspiration and new industry developments to clients and leading by example across Business Services and the Group to bring the expertise forward on Business Services account(s) from transformation, delivery, and technology

* Being a good listener and be able to collaborate with various internal functions and business lines of Capgemini
* Must have a strategic mindset supported by a strong track record in driving the results and achieving measurable outcomes, as well as excellent leadership and communication skills. Possess a deep understanding of industry, technology, and people market dynamics.

Secondary Skills
  
  
**Qualifications (Competencies/Education/Experience/Certification)**

* Possess a very strong operational understanding on Finance & Accounting
* Ability and experience to deep dive into operational issues, perform root cause, coach the teams on tools and methodologies and build a proactive control environment on business process
* Strong track record of transformation programs, driving results and achieving measurable outcomes.
* Strong knowledge and passion towards technology including AI/ML/Gen AI. Articulate use cases and value proposition of these tools
* Being an authentic leader and talent magnet. Be a mentor for Delivery leaders and groom future leaders
* Excellent leadership and communication skills
* Strategic mindset and out of the box thinking

Industry experience –C level role experience in a select industry or being a face off to CXO in select Industry will be added advantage.

title: Package Consultant-Workday HCM & Compensation
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. Youâ€™ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, youâ€™ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. Youâ€™ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Package Consultant specializing in Workday HCM and Compensation, you will apply consulting skills, business knowledge, and packaged solution expertise to configure the system to meet the client's business needs. You will play a key role in implementing and supporting the Workday core HCM and core compensation modules for clients.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Implement Core Modules: Configure the Workday core HCM and core compensation modules to meet the client's business needs, ensuring seamless integration and functionality.
* Conduct Fit Analysis: Gather requirements, perform fit analysis, and plan the implementation to ensure the system meets the client's business objectives.
* Resolve Configuration Issues: Identify and resolve configuration and functional issues across various core HCM and core compensation modules, providing timely and effective solutions.
* Deliver Post-Implementation Support: Provide ongoing support after implementation, addressing client queries and concerns, and making necessary adjustments to ensure continued system effectiveness.
* Perform Unit Testing: Conduct thorough unit testing to ensure the configured system meets the client's requirements and is free from defects.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Exposure to Workday HCM: Familiarity with configuring and implementing Workday core HCM modules, including setup and integration with other modules.
* Core Compensation Knowledge: Understanding of core compensation concepts and practices, with experience in configuring and supporting Workday core compensation modules.
* Implementation Planning: Experience with planning and conducting fit analysis to ensure seamless implementation of Workday core HCM and core compensation modules.
* Configuration and Troubleshooting: Exposure to identifying and resolving configuration and functional issues across various core HCM and core compensation modules.
* Unit Testing and Quality Assurance: Familiarity with conducting unit testing to ensure configured systems meet client requirements and are free from defects.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Workday Reporting Skills: Exposure to creating and customizing reports in Workday, including report writing and data analysis, to support client business needs.
* Cloud-Based Solutions: Familiarity with cloud-based HCM and compensation solutions, with an understanding of their integration and implementation.
* HR Business Processes: Understanding of HR business processes, including talent management, benefits administration, and payroll processing, to support Workday HCM and compensation module implementation.

title: LFR Regional Manager - East
description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
  
  
Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
  
  
Lenovo is looking for an experienced
**Regional Manager – LFR (Large Format Retail)**
to drive the
**its PC/ TAB /Accessories and Visuals SO**
across the assigned region. The role will be responsible for achieving revenue and market-share objectives through effective retail execution, partner management, category development, and strong collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive regional sales, revenue, market-share targets for PC/ TAB /Accessories and Visuals SO through LFR channels.
* Develop and execute the regional LFR sales strategy aligned with Lenovo’s business objectives.
* Manage relationships with key LFR partners such as Croma, Reliance Digital..
* Drive sell-out, inventory management, stock rotation and availability across the region.
* Build strong relationships with regional and store-level business stakeholders, ensuring effective execution of Lenovo’s product and promotional strategy.
* Lead category expansion and product launches, ensuring strong visibility and retail presence for Tablets and Accessories.
* Track and analyse sales performance, market trends, competition, pricing, inventory, and retailer productivity to identify growth opportunities.
* Drive retail execution, including merchandising, product visibility, promoter productivity, demonstrations, and in-store activations.
* Develop and monitor monthly/quarterly sales plans, forecasts and business reviews.
* Ensure effective execution of promotional schemes, incentives, and trade programs .
* Identify gaps in distribution, assortment and retail coverage and implement corrective actions.

title: Professional Services Engineer
description:
**ABOUT XPLORETEQ**

Xploreteq is a Pune-based technology and cybersecurity company working with organisations across cybersecurity, AI governance, data protection and DPDP readiness — through advisory, implementation and managed services. We are ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, serve 50+ enterprise customers across financial services, healthcare, technology, manufacturing and services, and partner with leading platforms including Netskope, CrowdStrike, Menlo Security, Proofpoint, Okta, Varonis and Forcepoint. As we scale our team across sales, delivery and operations, we're looking for people who want to build a specialist practice rather than join a generalist IT shop.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a client-facing Professional Services Engineer to lead the technical implementation, architecture and integration of edge security solutions for our enterprise clients. Working from a System Integrator perspective, you will assess client environments, design the deployment architecture, and execute migrations onto modern Zero-Trust platforms — bridging legacy infrastructure (on-prem proxies, MPLS) and cloud-native SASE/SSE.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Assessment & Design**

•   Lead technical discovery workshops to map legacy architecture, application portfolios and traffic flows.

•   Author High-Level and Low-Level Design documentation covering traffic steering, proxy chaining, SSL decryption policy and fallback mechanisms.

•   Help clients plan prerequisites — allowlists, firewall exceptions, certificate authority provisioning, IdP sync.

**SASE/SSE Implementation**

•   Build, configure and validate tenants covering Secure Web Gateway, CASB and ZTNA.

•   Implement DLP policies aligned to client regulatory requirements (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, DPDP) with custom detection rules.

•   Configure traffic steering and client deployment via MDM/GPO, including bypass and smart-steering rules.

•   Deploy Remote Browser Isolation and content-sanitisation (CDR) controls where in scope.

**Integration & Go-Live**

•   Integrate platforms with client Identity Providers (Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta) for provisioning and group-based policy.

•   Configure log/event forwarding into the client's SIEM (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, etc.).

•   Design and execute UAT test matrices; provide post-go-live hypercare support; run technical training and handover sessions for the client's internal operations team.

**REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

•   3–6 years as a Cyber Security Engineer, Consultant or Professional Services engineer, ideally within a System Integrator or MSP.

•   Hands-on deployment experience with at least one SASE/SSE platform (Netskope preferred) or isolation platform (Menlo Security); familiarity with a second (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Forcepoint) is a strong plus.

•   Working knowledge of proxy configuration (PAC files, explicit vs. transparent), GRE/IPsec tunnelling, TLS/SSL inspection and routing fundamentals.

•   Experience deploying endpoint agents at scale via Intune, SCCM, JAMF or GPO.

**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS**

•   Netskope Cloud Security Integrator (NCSI) or Cloud Security Administrator (NCSA).

•   Palo Alto PCNSE, CISSP or CCSP are a plus.

**COMPETENCIES & SOFT SKILLS**

•   Comfortable walking into varied, unpredictable client environments and deploying a modern security stack on top of messy legacy networks.

•   Strong documentation discipline for HLD/LLDs and runbooks.

•   Able to run more than one client engagement at different lifecycle stages at once.

**WHAT WE VALUE**

At Xploreteq, we value people who take responsibility, communicate openly, solve problems practically, and contribute beyond the boundaries of a job description. For this role, we're particularly looking for someone who can be dropped into a messy client environment and bring order to it.

**REPORTING**

Reports to the Tech Lead.

**TO APPLY**

Interested candidates can share their updated CV to HR@xploreteq.com along with:

•   Current CTC

•   Expected CTC

•   Notice period

•   Current location

•   Brief summary of relevant experience for this role

title: Workiva-Senior
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS FAAS (Controllership Transformation) \- Senior position**
 At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provide advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced professional with strong focus on Enterprise Performance management (EPM) areas to join EY FAAS team. The ideal candidate will bring subject matter expertise in FP\&A and/or Consolidation \& Reporting processes to enhance our FAAS services.
   

  

 Within EY FAAS practice, the Finance Transformation Experts team build and develop client relationship with our regional stakeholders. We are part of an integrated global network of professionals who develop, design and optimise client service business processes for efficiency and high performance. We leverage and improve various frameworks, methodologies, solutions specific to our offerings and articulate presentations that communicate proposals, strategies, plans and outcomes.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Technical Delivery and Subject Matter Expertise \-
+ Working with clients to understand business challenges and identify solution to drive desired outcomes
+ Performing current state assessment of client accounting, reporting, and reconciliation
+ Developing system requirements, designing, user acceptance test stories, training, defining support procedure and implementing with specific focus on Workiva Wdesk, Wdata and integration with data source system/s
+ Mapping data flow and to identify optimal design and governance option as well as potential risk
+ Using Wdata \& Wdesk to create templates, connections, data flows, integrations, etc
+ Focus accounting and finance domain area of reporting and data management including financial, management regulatory reporting, internal controls, global statutory reporting
+ Redesign processes to eliminate inefficiencies and incorporate best practices
+ Stay updated with the latest industry trends, regulations, and advancements in reporting optimization process, sharing knowledge and insights with the team
+ Support project management activities, including project planning, resource allocation, and monitoring project progress
+ Proficient in developing KPIs, performance value driver analysis, and implementing Driver based planning models
+ Develop detailed documentation and deliver training programs and workshops to enhance end user understanding and proficiency in Reporting solution during the handover


* Business Development \& Solution Development \-
+ Lead pursuit teams to understand client problem statements \& formulate that in solutions
+ Lead developing client specific solutions for the engagement team
+ Lead proposal development or lead proposal teams
+ Lead collaboration with market teams to develop relationship and drive business growth for EY
+ Collaborate cross service lines to ensure smooth execution of the project.
+ Lead development of internal capability development and lead training sessions to coach internal teams to develop capability
+ Lead operational initiatives within the practice areas.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Business Skills and Knowledge –
+ Strong business development skills
+ Very strong solution conceptualization/ideation skill
+ Strong solution/product build skills
+ Strong project management skills


* Human Skills –
+ Excellent written \& oral communication \& articulation
+ Flexible work attitude
+ Proven ability to lead diverse team over multiple geographies
+ Strong collaboration skills
+ Ability to comprehend complexity quickly \& apply solutions
+ Comfort in dealing with ambiguity
+ Strong entrepreneurial skills in terms of ownership of problem \& solutions
+ Strong problem solving skills
+ Ability to perform effectively under pressure and deliver results
+ Willingness to travel for short or long duration at short notice


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Graduate or MBA with 2\-6 years of relevant experience
* Experience in end\-to\-end implementation of Workiva solution in Financial Reporting, ESG and GRC space.
* Experience in current state analysis (As is), future state analysis (To be), process optimization, process documentation, data integration, and data analytics
* Strong communication, team building, teaming and presentation experience
* Experience in SQL and system integration
* Experience with ETL tools (Power BI, Alteryx)
* Experience in leading and developing team
* Demonstrated problem solving and critical thinking skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments/responsibilities
* Experience and certified with Workiva solution.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Specialist - Global Trade System
description:
It's about Being What's next.
 **What's in it for you?**

 The Specialist in this position will be offering the full scale of global functional SAP Global Trade System services to corporate and regional units around the globe. Also, provide support and define global trade processes, manage embargoes, and offers a solution for Denied Party Screening of Linde’s business partners.
   

  

 At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on\-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
   

  

 Team
   

  


 Making an impact.
 **What will you do?**

* In this role, you will proactive consulting services based on industry practices leveraging previous project experiences in the SAP GTS areas as described (incl. e.g. user authorisations, reports, jobs, table structures, new functionality, system integration/interfaces)
* You will be part of Business projects and enhancements/continuous improvements lik analysis of user requirement received from customer/work effort estimation/create functional specification documenting the solution
* Create the functional solution design which includes SAP standard customizing as well as technical specifications delivered by the development team by using SAP SolMan as Change Management system
* And Perform unit testing, system integration\- \& functional (IT\-) testing
* Supporting customer during user acceptance testing and regression testing. Resolve defects identified during the testing cycles. Support cut over planning/execution and hyper care phase after go\-live
* Conducting workshops and training sessions to gather requirements and provide knowledge transfer
* You will be contributing to Incident Management / Service requests (3rd Level Support) incl. analyzing and resolving the reported issue
* Supporting to perform system upgrades, integrations, and testing



 Winning in your role.
 **Do you have what it takes?**

* Must have at least 3 years of experience in a SAP GTS solution based functional role.
* Academic degree in Business Administration or – Informatics or a certificated IT education min. 4\+ year professional experience in IT processes and ITIL
* Also, practical experience of IT Service Management Processes such as software change and/or release management or application management experience
* You must have the ability to debug SAP code to a certain extent to resolve low level incidents.
* Experience in SAP GTS Edition for Hana with debugging, integration knowledge with other SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Also, effective communication skills are required to influence stakeholders to achieve support and consistency of the overall IT strategies and policies, specifically in their own subject areas.
* Must have excellent analytical skills, together with the ability to think "outside the box".
* Foreign Trade Zone handling within GTS incl. Material balancing



**Why you will love working for us!**

 Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high\-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals \& energy, food \& beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra\-high\-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life\-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state\-of\-the\-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
   

  

 Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006\. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
   

  

 At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
   

  

 Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
   

  

 For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com
   

  

 Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
   

  

 We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.
   

  

 Any designations used of course apply to persons of all genders. The form of speech used here is for simplicity only.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.
   

  

 Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development.

title: Market Access Manager
description:

**Company: Novo Nordisk India Pvt. Ltd**
**Your impact begins here**
 As Market Access Manager, you will strengthen how Novo Nordisk engages payers, shapes therapy access and manages key accounts across your market. You will connect commercial strategy with market access execution — identifying external opportunities, building account\-based plans and helping secure formulary presence for our portfolio. By bringing together insight, cross\-functional collaboration and practical action, you will help ensure that more people living with serious chronic diseases can access the treatments they need. Your impact starts today.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* A Master's degree, preferably within a quantitative or management discipline, from a well\-recognised institute.
* 5\+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Direct experience in at least two of the following areas: Pricing, Outcomes Research, Health Economics, Brand Value Communications, Advocacy Development, Payer Engagement, Market Access, Customer Insight Gathering, Customer Value Proposition Development, or Negotiation and Business Acquisition.
* Experience building relationships and networks with healthcare decision\-makers, including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders.
* A track record of delivering business objectives in alignment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* The ability to analyse complex issues, apply strategic thinking and implement tactical plans.
* Experience articulating complex market access topics clearly and persuasively to key decision\-makers.
* Commercial, business or medical experience at a managerial level, with the ability to work effectively within cross\-functional teams.


**Useful, But Not Essential**
* Exposure to areas beyond your direct experience listed above.


**What You'll Do**
* Shape therapy access strategies for new and existing launches by identifying market opportunities, planning account\-based approaches and ensuring budget allocation for Novo Nordisk therapy areas.
* Manage national key accounts — including ESI, Railway, CGHS and Army — driving aligned actions across commercial functions to strengthen product presence and formulary inclusion.
* Coordinate with Sales Managers and Key Account Managers on state tenders, tracking product cycles across institutional accounts and providing regular updates on tender and account status.
* Train and support Key Account Managers on account management practices, collaborating with Sales, Marketing and People \& Organisation to build capability.
* Serve as the single point of contact for therapy access knowledge, connecting global materials and up\-to\-date product information with local teams and institutional partners.
* Support the institution team in filing tenders by providing accurate, current documentation and product information.


**Who You'll Work With**
 You will join a market access team within Rare Disease \& Public Care, working at the intersection of commercial strategy and payer engagement. Your closest partners will be colleagues across Marketing, CMR, Sales, Key Account Management and medical functions within the affiliate.
   

  

 Externally, you will build and maintain a broad network of stakeholders with influence on market access outcomes — including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders. You will also connect with regional and global market access colleagues to share learning and align on priorities.
   

  

 The role is cross\-functional by nature. You will bring different perspectives together, create clarity around account priorities and help teams move from insight to action across therapy areas.
   

  

**What You Can Expect Here**
 You will work in an environment where your expertise in payer engagement and account strategy directly shapes commercial outcomes. The role offers the opportunity to deepen your market access skills, collaborate across functions and contribute to work that expands treatment access for people living with serious chronic diseases.
   

  

 You will be trusted to take ownership of your accounts and priorities, supported to develop new capabilities and encouraged to share your perspective. Cross\-functional collaboration, honest feedback and a focus on results define how the team works together.
   

  

**Start now**
 Your impact begins today. If you are ready to strengthen therapy access and help more people benefit from Novo Nordisk's portfolio, apply for the Market Access Manager role by 24 September 2026\. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Sizing Analyst
description:
**Department:** 
 Sales
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata / Gurgaon
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Salary:** 
 10\-12 LPA
 



  





**About Triphos** 




 Triphos Power is a full\-stack battery\-as\-a\-service company focused on commercial and industrial (C\&I) customers. We finance, own, deploy, operate, and maintain battery storage systems, backed by our own in\-house Energy Management System (EMS) — putting us at the intersection of system integration, battery portfolio management, and technology. Our target is 100 MWh across 30–40 C\&I sites in Year 1, scaling to a gigawatt\-hour\-plus portfolio within three years. We're backed by the promoter family of Rupa \& Co. and Neo Metaliks, giving us capital strength, distribution expertise, and a warm C\&I customer pipeline from day one.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Every Triphos proposal starts with a number: how much battery a site actually needs, and what it saves the customer. The Sizing Analyst owns that number. You'll work directly with C\&I clients to pull the load, tariff, and consumption data we need, clean it into something usable, and run the sizing and feasibility analysis behind every deal. Your output is the package the customer decides on — a full sizing report, a savings analysis, and a financial model with a clear ROI case. As we push toward 100 MWh across 30–40 sites in Year 1, this analysis is what separates a deal that closes and performs from one that doesn't.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the client data pipeline end to end — work through the data questionnaire with C\&I clients, understand exactly what's needed from each site, and follow up until it lands
* Clean, structure, and validate large, messy client datasets into analysis\-ready inputs
* Run sizing and optimization analysis to determine the right battery configuration for each site
* Determine which use case fits each client best — peak shaving, time\-of\-day arbitrage, renewable integration — based on what the data actually shows
* Research and interpret state tariff orders, electricity bills, penalty structures, and open access regulations to ground every analysis in real numbers
* Build savings analyses that quantify what the customer actually stands to gain
* Produce the full BESS feasibility analysis report for each site
* Communicate directly with clients throughout — chasing data, clarifying assumptions, and keeping the process moving
* Contribute to automating and streamlining the analysis process as we scale



  





**Key Requirements / Skills** 



* 0–3 years of experience
* BSc or higher in Operations Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative field
* Strong expertise in Excel, Python, SQL, or similar analytical tools
* Strong with numbers, with a solid grounding in optimization, statistics, and sharp problem\-solving instincts
* Basic electrical knowledge, or willingness to pick it up quickly



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 Your analysis drives real investment decisions on both sides, so we want someone who feels that weight and checks their work accordingly.
 


* Meticulous — you go through data line by line because you know what rides on it
* Mathematically sharp, with the instinct to spot a number that looks wrong
* A clear communicator who builds rapport with clients and gets the data you need fast
* Comfortable working directly with C\&I customers
* High ownership and hands\-on, in a small, fast\-moving team



  





**How to Apply** 



* Send your resume and a note under 200 words on why you think you are the right fit to hr@triphospower.com.

Our Business Modelling group helps create social and economic value for our clients by helping them make more informed steps about strategically managing capital and transactions. * Advanced knowledge and experience in any of the following sectors will be added advantage – Industrials and Automotive, Consumer Product and Retail, Healthcare and Life sciences, Private Equity, Wealth and Asset Management, Banking and Capital Market.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* A minimum of 6\-8 years of relevant experience with a national valuation firm or accounting firm’s business modelling practice, or in quantitative management or litigation consulting, investment banking, private equity/venture capital or commercial banking


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Should have developed / reviewed models in Excel/VBA. Additional skills in R, Python related financial modelling is a plus.

From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

 Engage C\-suite and key decision makers at customers’ Americas headquarters during all critical stages of the strategic customer sales cycle.

* Customer account management

* Chanel Partners handling

**We Value**
* MBA in business development

 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world.  **5–7 years of hands\-on experience specifically in restaurant onboarding, restaurant acquisition, merchant acquisition, food\-tech partnerships, or restaurant account management within the online food delivery ecosystem.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Restaurant Acquisition \& Market Expansion
 


* Own restaurant acquisition and onboarding targets across assigned territories, zones, and markets.
* Identify high\-potential restaurants, QSRs, cloud kitchens, local food brands, restaurant chains, and strategic merchant partners.
* Develop market\-level acquisition strategies based on cuisine gaps, customer demand, locality coverage, pricing, and restaurant popularity.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective restaurant partners.
* Conduct regular market mapping and identify restaurants currently missing from Gintaa's portfolio.
* Drive both field\-based and strategic restaurant acquisition initiatives.
* Support Gintaa's expansion into new locations by rapidly developing the restaurant supply base.



  





 2\. Restaurant Onboarding
 


* Manage the complete restaurant onboarding lifecycle from initial contact to successful activation.
* Coordinate collection and verification of required restaurant information and documentation.
* Ensure restaurant profiles, menus, pricing, operating hours, images, bank details, tax information, and other required information are accurately captured.
* Coordinate internally for account creation and platform configuration.
* Ensure onboarding activities are completed within defined turnaround times.
* Maintain high onboarding quality and minimize errors that could affect restaurant operations or customer experience.



  





 3\. Commercial Negotiation \& Partner Conversion
 


* Conduct commercial discussions with restaurant owners, decision\-makers, and management teams.
* Clearly communicate Gintaa's value proposition and partnership model.
* Negotiate commercials and partnership terms within approved company guidelines.
* Handle objections and competitive comparisons effectively.
* Drive conversion of qualified restaurant leads into active partners.
* Maintain transparency in all commercial commitments made to restaurant partners.



  





 4\. Restaurant Activation \& Go\-Live
 


* Own the journey from
 **Lead → Meeting → Agreement → Documentation → Menu Setup → Onboarding → Go\-Live → First Order** 
 .
* Ensure newly onboarded restaurants become operational within the defined activation timeline.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners to resolve issues delaying activation.
* Track restaurants that have completed onboarding but have not gone live or received orders.
* Drive activation and first\-order completion for newly onboarded partners.
* Ensure restaurant partners understand the operational workflow before going live.



  





 5\. Menu \& Catalogue Readiness
 


* Ensure restaurant menus are accurately represented on the Gintaa platform.
* Coordinate menu collection, item categorization, pricing, descriptions, images, availability, add\-ons, and customization requirements.
* Ensure restaurant information including address, operating hours, cuisines, and contact details is accurate.
* Work closely with catalogue/content teams to minimize menu\-related errors.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners for timely menu updates whenever required.



  





 6\. Partner Training \& Operational Readiness
 


* Educate newly onboarded restaurant partners on order acceptance and management processes.
* Explain platform workflows, restaurant responsibilities, delivery coordination, cancellations, customer issues, and escalation procedures.
* Ensure restaurant staff understand how to efficiently manage online orders.
* Provide initial operational support during the restaurant's launch phase.
* Reduce early\-stage operational issues through effective onboarding and training.



  





 7\. Restaurant Partner Relationship Management
 


* Build strong working relationships with restaurant owners and key decision\-makers.
* Act as an escalation point during the initial onboarding and activation period.
* Understand restaurant partner concerns and coordinate internally for resolution.
* Maintain high levels of partner satisfaction throughout the onboarding journey.
* Ensure smooth handover of successfully activated restaurants to the relevant account management or restaurant operations team.



  





 8\. Team Management \& Leadership
 


* Lead and mentor Restaurant Acquisition Managers, Onboarding Executives, Business Development Executives, and field teams.
* Allocate territories and acquisition targets based on market potential.
* Conduct daily and weekly pipeline reviews with the team.
* Track individual and team\-level performance against defined targets.
* Coach team members on pitching, negotiation, objection handling, and restaurant conversion.
* Build a high\-performance culture focused on acquisition quality, speed, ownership, and execution.



  





 9\. Market Intelligence \& Competition Tracking
 


* Maintain strong awareness of the local restaurant and food delivery ecosystem.
* Track competitor restaurant partnerships, market penetration, restaurant offers, and acquisition activities.
* Gather structured feedback from restaurant partners regarding market trends and competitor propositions.
* Identify cuisine, pricing, locality, and restaurant\-selection gaps in Gintaa's marketplace.
* Share actionable market intelligence with business leadership.



  





 10\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
 



 Work closely with:
 


* Restaurant Operations
* Catalogue/Menu Management
* Sales \& Business Development
* Finance
* Legal/Compliance
* Customer Support
* Delivery Operations
* Product \& Technology
* Marketing



  





 Ensure smooth movement of restaurant partners across the entire acquisition, onboarding, activation, and operational handover journey.
 



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 Performance for this role will primarily be measured through:
 


* Number of Restaurants Acquired
* Qualified Lead\-to\-Onboarding Conversion %
* Restaurants Onboarded per Month
* Restaurant Activation / Go\-Live Rate
* Average Onboarding TAT
* Documentation Completion Rate
* Menu/Listing Accuracy
* Agreement\-to\-Go\-Live TAT
* Onboarding\-to\-First\-Order Conversion
* Restaurant Partner Drop\-Off Rate
* Acquisition Cost per Restaurant
* Restaurant Coverage by Zone
* Target vs. Achievement
* Team Productivity
* Restaurant Partner Satisfaction



  





 Required Experience \& Qualifications
 


* **5–7 years of relevant professional experience.**
* **Prior experience in the same domain – restaurant acquisition, restaurant onboarding, food\-tech merchant acquisition, or restaurant partnerships – is MANDATORY.**
* **Candidates without relevant restaurant/food\-delivery onboarding or acquisition experience will not be considered for this position.**
* **Proven experience working directly with restaurant owners, restaurant chains, QSRs, cloud kitchens, or food\-service businesses.**
* **Strong experience in restaurant acquisition, onboarding, activation, and commercial negotiations.**
* **Experience managing field sales/acquisition teams and territory\-level targets.**
* **Strong understanding of online food delivery marketplace operations.**
* **Graduate degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Hospitality, or a related discipline.**
* **MBA/PGDM will be an advantage.**
* **Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, CRM systems, MIS reporting, and performance dashboards.**
* **Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.**
* **Willingness to travel extensively within assigned markets and interact directly with restaurant partners.**
